title: Zymo Duet DNA/RNA MiniPrep Plus Extractions
author: Amy Lyden
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.umteu6n
materials: If not homogenized, tissuelyse on Qiagen Tissuelyser II in bead bashing tube for desired amount of time at a frequency of 1/30 s. Alternatively, vortex at the highest frequency. Add one part DNA/RNA Lysis buffer (ie 200 µL of sample in DNA/RNA shield to 200 µL of lysis buffer). Proceed with Nucleic Acid Purification.

steps.title: Prepare Samples (Option 1: Colony/Tissue)
steps.instruction: Prepare the sample for lysis using either DNA/RNA shield or lysis buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 320 µL 1X DNA/RNA shield (2x concentrate diluted in nuclease-free water) to bead bashing tubes and add selected colonies.
Tissuelyse on Qiagen Tissuelyser II for 2 minutes at a frequency of 1/30 s, or alternatively, vortex at the highest frequency for 2 minutes.
Spin for 1 minute at 14000 RCF.
Add 320 µL of DNA/RNA Lysis buffer.

steps.title: Prepare Samples (Option 2: General Tissue)
steps.instruction: Lyse sample using a 1:3 ratio of sample to lysis buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 part sample to 3 parts DNA/RNA lysis buffer (e.g., 100 µL sample to 300 µL lysis buffer) in a bead bashing tube.
Tissuelyse on Qiagen Tissuelyser II for 1 minute at a frequency of 1/30 s, or alternatively, vortex at the highest frequency for 1 minute.
Spin for 1 minute at 14000 RCF.

steps.title: Prepare Samples (Option 3: Blood)
steps.instruction: Process blood samples with DNA/RNA shield and Proteinase K.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL of 2X DNA/RNA shield to each 200 µL of blood sample and mix thoroughly.
Add 8 µL of reconstituted Proteinase K for every 400 µL of reagent/blood mixture and mix thoroughly.
Incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Add an equal volume of isopropanol to the mixture and mix by vortexing.

steps.title: DNA Binding (Yellow Column)
steps.instruction: Bind DNA to the Spin-Away Filter (yellow).

substeps.instruction: Label a Spin-Away Filter (yellow) and a microcentrifuge tube for each sample.
Transfer up to 700 µL of the sample into a Spin-Away Filter (yellow) in a Collection Tube and centrifuge for 30 seconds at 16000 RCF.
If sample volume is > 700 µL, reload the column and centrifuge again.

For whole blood ONLY: discard the initial flow-through, add 200 µL of DNA/RNA Lysis buffer directly to the filter matrix, let stand for 5 minutes, then centrifuge for 30 seconds at 16000 RCF. Save this flow-through for RNA purification.

steps.title: RNA Sample Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the flow-through from the yellow column for RNA purification.

substeps.instruction: Save the flow-through from the yellow column (if not using whole blood, discard if RNA purification is not desired).
Transfer flow-through into an Eppendorf tube if necessary.
Add an equal volume of ethanol (95-100%) to the flow-through and mix well.

steps.title: RNA Binding (Green Column)
steps.instruction: Bind RNA to the Zymo-Spin IIICG Column (green).

substeps.instruction: Transfer up to 700 µL of the ethanol-mixed sample into a Zymo-Spin IIICG Column (green) in a Collection Tube and centrifuge for 30 seconds at 16000 RCF.
Discard the flow-through.
Repeat by reloading the column if more sample remains.

steps.title: RNA DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Remove DNA from the RNA column using DNase I.

substeps.instruction: Add 80 µL DNase I Reaction Mix (5 µL reconstituted DNAse + 75 µL DNA Digestion Buffer) directly to the green column matrix.
Incubate the column at room temperature (20 °C - 30 °C) for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Column Washing and Purification
steps.instruction: Wash both yellow and green columns to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Wash the green column with 400 µL DNA/RNA Wash Buffer and centrifuge for 30 seconds at 16000 RCF; discard flow-through.
Add 400 µL DNA/RNA Prep Buffer to both the yellow and green columns and centrifuge for 30 seconds at 16000 RCF; discard flow-through.
Add 700 µL DNA/RNA Wash Buffer to both columns and centrifuge for 30 seconds at 16000 RCF; discard flow-through.
Add 400 µL DNA/RNA Wash Buffer to both columns and centrifuge for 2 minutes at 16000 RCF to ensure complete removal of wash buffer.

steps.title: Elution of Nucleic Acids
steps.instruction: Elute DNA and RNA from their respective columns.

substeps.instruction: Carefully transfer the columns into clean microcentrifuge/Eppendorf tubes.
Add 50 µL DNase/RNase-Free Water directly to the column matrix, let stand for 5 minutes, and centrifuge for 30 seconds at 16000 RCF.
Take the 50 µL of eluted DNA/RNA and reload it onto the column.
Let stand for 5 minutes and centrifuge for 1 minute at 16000 RCF to maximize recovery.

steps.title: Storage
steps.instruction: Store the purified nucleic acids at appropriate temperatures.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot RNA into single-use tubes and freeze at -80 °C.
Freeze DNA at -20 °C or -80 °C.
